source_frozen.official_first_redirect_policy: Use preverified Dryad exact first Lambda host contract from validation/independent_movement_source_gate_v2/protocol_v2.json. If host differs, STOP; do not widen allowlist after outcome.

source_inference.actual_source: Published depart_lat/depart_lon colony derived from original banding, not continuous flight route or full source truth
source_inference.target: Published arrive_lat/arrive_lon colony of later breeding; date/year is publication's event year, NOT guaranteed provenance as-of availability
source_inference.historical_alternative_catalogue: All distinct rounded departure colony coordinates from original two published event tables with event year <=1975 only. Do not use arrival locations or any event year >=1976 to build catalogue.
source_inference.group_holdout: Analyze all event rows with year >=1976 from both original files as separate natal and breeding event-grain groups; historical roster fixed once.
source_inference.comparison_catalogue_for_each_event: Earlier-year catalogue ∪ {this event's banding-derived own departure coordinate}; union ensures source-specific original hypothesis is always contained, so r_possible<=r_actual by tautology.
source_inference.time_information_boundary: The historical year partition is a retrospective index partition. Because raw ring numbers and actual database-entry timestamps are unavailable, do NOT call candidate catalogue prospectively known as of 1975.
source_inference.biological_event_unit: One published dispersal event row; UID is sequential event ID rather than individual ring identifier. No independent individual-based confidence interval, significance test, or incidence estimate.
source_inference.published_scope: Published archive only includes selected dispersal events, not zero/dispersal stayers or surveyed non-detections, so movement probability and occupancy absent.
source_inference.coordinate_uncertainty: Lat/lon rounded to 0.01 degree by original README, so geographic radius in km cannot be treated as metre-precise true movement.

frozen_estimands.geographic_distance: Haversine great circle from rounded WGS84 departure/arrival colony latitude-longitude; publisher distance_km independently quality checked within 2.0 km
frozen_estimands.actual_origin_required_radius_km: r_actual_i = d(published departure_i, published later breeding arrival_i)
frozen_estimands.weak_existence_required_radius_km: r_any_i = min{r_actual_i, min_{c in original <=1975 catalog}d(c, arrival_i)}
frozen_estimands.geometric_optimism_gap_km: g_i=r_actual_i-r_any_i>=0 by construction; never call positive gap a mathematical discovery.
frozen_estimands.counterfactual_false_assurance: I(r_actual_i>R AND r_any_i<=R), among published relocation event rows.
frozen_estimands.robust_false_assurance_to_coordinate_rou: I(r_actual_i>R+2km AND r_any_i<R-2km), conservative 2km margin per endpoint distance; ambiguous cases retained in total.
frozen_estimands.primary_descriptive_readout: For each of natal and adult event groups, count number/denominator of source-specific-infeasible but source-agnostic-feasible events at R=20km; report same for coordinate-uncertain robust margin. No preregistered biological sign difference between groups.
frozen_estimands.secondary: For all 4 thresholds give actual_source_feasible, any_source_feasible, false_assurance, robust_margin_false_assurance; source catalogue size, group eligible event counts, medians/means of original and any-source distances and gaps, and fractions with optimism gap>2 km. No p-values.
frozen_estimands.no_new_ecological_effect_claim: The original Li et al 2026 paper already reports longer natal than adult movements. Do not relabel their observed distance contrast as an EOG discovery.

no_leakage_and_QA.source_identity: Exact 5 file SHA and byte lengths match source manifest before CSV decode; ZIP member basename and safe path checks.
no_leakage_and_QA.row_counts: Exactly 200+890 original data rows and all 8 original columns in both files; avoid posthoc filtering for sign or geographic distance.
no_leakage_and_QA.uid: UID nonempty, unique within each table; no assumption this identifies unique individuals across events.
no_leakage_and_QA.numeric: All finite valid WGS84 coordinates and nonnegative publisher distance_km; no missing tokens in public events as declared by publisher. If missing, STOP not quiet exclusions.
no_leakage_and_QA.no_actual_flight_events: Arrival location not a single unbroken dispersal flight path, no elapsed-time movement rate.
no_leakage_and_QA.published_distance_check: At least 95% of 1090 derived distance_km agree with haversine from published 0.01° rounded endpoints within ±2.0 km. If below, STOP; do not tune tolerance.
no_leakage_and_QA.arithmetic: Validate r_any<=r_actual for all events, nonnegative gap within 1e-9, robust false assurance subset of apparent false assurance, group counts sum to original 1090.
no_leakage_and_QA.identical_coordinates: Allow coordinate duplicates because original locations rounded to 0.01°, do not fabricate extra colony IDs.
no_leakage_and_QA.source_catalogue_metadata_export: Only number of distinct coordinates, not locations or row-level movements.

claim_boundary.positive_result_interpretation: Can quantify ecological event-grain false assurance of source-agnostic explanations when marked departure colony has been recorded, conditional on a retrospectively assembled source catalogue. The monotone inequality is not new mathematics.
not_inferable: effects of environmental tolerance, species interactions or hard barriers
